description: This file defines a C# interface for serializing value types within the Orleans serialization framework. It declares generic methods for serialization and deserialization of value types and includes a marker interface for serializers.

classes.name: IValueSerializer<T>
classes.description: Generic interface for serializing value types in Orleans serialization.

classes.name: IValueSerializer
classes.description: Marker interface for value type serializers.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes a value of type T into a buffer writer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data from a reader into a value of type T.
